notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around a standard timestamped object-removal callback. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies suppression and release of timestamped object removal and time-advance grant callbacks, exact object/tag/time/order/retraction metadata, object-name retirement after delivery, callback ordering at the grant boundary, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with publishObjectClassAttributes/registerObjectInstance/deleteObjectInstance(time)/timeAdvanceRequest and FederateAmbassador removeObjectInstance(time)/timeAdvanceGrant delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and timestamped object-removal declarations
